name: Comprador
tagline: Watches drops and restocks, then checks out for you once you approve
description: Hand it a product link and it keeps watch on launches and restocks, joins the queue at the right moment, and carries the order through to checkout on a connected agent virtual card with a spending cap. Every single purchase stops for your approval before any payment is released.
author: whymentc
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
